addition:
**Accepted optional detached projection preparation (STUDIO-OBS-007).** The production assembler/service factory may privately enable a known-pure preparation capability tied to the same assembler epoch used by classification. Public/manual/nonstandard construction keeps the original locked path; no controller/job/configuration flag can select a capability. An extra read transaction repeats fresh authorization/source/owner and the complete original materialization/helper validations, then detaches only the original masked positive model context. Planning-context validation, defensive projection copying and reusable escaped-wire sizing may run off lock. No preparation accounting, recovery normalization, model reservation/send or cached deadline occurs.

Actual reservation retains original fresh guards, accounting and abandoned-attempt settlement, and rereads the owner after nested settlement rather than trusting the old detached wrapper. It repeats full materialization validation and original prompt-input/helper refusals. Only exact fresh context, representation, kind/attempt/repairs/output cap/static metadata and actual recovery-key compatibility allow reuse; any mismatch uses the original locked computation without another request, send or charge. Both original provenance observations remain exclusively at their actual reservation points. Full runner-context/lease equality is never a cached validation certificate: renewal is handled by fresh full validation.

Known fixed typed preparation failures are deferred to their original guarded validation point only when fresh inputs match. Unexpected nonfatal preparation failure makes the optimization unavailable and the original computation decides the outcome; fatal `Error` propagates immediately and is not retained. These extra read/validation/Error observations, possible fallback work and the fresh-after-settlement read are deliberate semantics, not observational equivalence. Full materialization validation still holds the lock in both captures; no one-second performance guarantee is claimed. Backend full TRACE/privacy, current authority, atomic accounting and existing timing bounds remain mandatory.
